What's the ticket inflow trend compared to last week?

WITH weekly_tickets AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN CREATED_AT_PST >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'This Week'
            WHEN CREATED_AT_PST >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '14 days' THEN 'Last Week'
        END as week_period,
        COUNT(*) as ticket_count
    FROM ANALYTICS.DBT_PRODUCTION.RPT_WOPS_TICKETS
    WHERE CREATED_AT_PST >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 
    week_period,
    ticket_count,
    LAG(ticket_count) OVER (ORDER BY week_period) as prev_week_count,
    ticket_count - LAG(ticket_count) OVER (ORDER BY week_period) as change_from_prev_week
FROM weekly_tickets
WHERE week_period IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY week_period
